create_group_section: create a GroupSection report section that groups multiple child report sections together with a title and optional anchor
build_group_section_collapsible: build a GroupSection with collapsible enabled and a custom anchor for nested report sections
test_group_section_header_includes: test the GroupSection header_includes method to collect header includes from all child sections
review_group_section_get_context: review the GroupSection get_context method that returns title and anchor for template rendering
summarize_group_section_template: summarize the GroupSection template_filename property that returns group.html for Jinja2 rendering
